alex: Quick smoke from the last run — iso mixed-traffic (chat + completion) across eu-west1 / us-east1, 7B + 13B. Posting summary numbers, ask for raw traces if useful.
benchbot: auto-summary: run_id=run-3781, config=q4_0 on both skus for 7B, q8x4 on 13B, batch target=8, tail_latency_slo=200ms.
alex: Key takeaways first: H100 wins on tokens/sec across both models and reduces $/1M tokens despite higher per-GPU cost due to throughput. Prefill still dominates latency for long contexts; decode improvements on H100 are noticeable for small batch sizes.
priya: Can you drop the main table?
alex: Sure — pasted raw-ish numbers (median p50 prefill/decode in ms, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens measured with our pricing model and average utilization).
alex: ```
model    | gpu  | prefill_p50_ms | decode_p50_ms | tok/sec | $/1M_tokens
Mosaic-7B| A100 | 48             | 95            | 620     | $4.6
Mosaic-7B| H100 | 36             | 70            | 880     | $4.0
Mistral-7B| A100| 52             | 110           | 590     | $4.9
Mistral-7B| H100| 39             | 82            | 830     | $4.2
Llama-13B| A100 | 120            | 260           | 285     | $8.8
Llama-13B| H100 | 90             | 200           | 420     | $7.6
```
jen: Nice. How are you computing $/1M_tokens? which instance/hour costs?
alex: We used committed SKU cost: A100@4k/hr, H100@5.4k/hr (internal normalized units), subtracting GPU utilization overhead (average 72% observed). Then divide by measured tok/sec extrapolated to 1M. It's consistent with our internal dollar model.
sam: Were these single-GPU tests or multi-GPU slotted? Prefill can be multi-stage.
alex: Single-GPU inference runs (no tensor-slicing across gpus). For 13B we pinned to single-GPU q4_0 where possible; 13B on q8x4 for A100 run because q4_0 fallback wasn't stable on that kernel.
priya: Any kernel fallbacks observed?
alex: Yes — on A100 for Llama-13B we saw occasional kernel fallback to `gemm_slowpath` at >1024 seq, which cost ~15-25% decode time. H100 used fast kernels consistently for the tested seq lengths (<=2048).
jen: Did you try prefix/KV caching? That shifts the prefill vs decode split.
alex: We did a kv-hit run for Mosaic-7B: with 40% kv-hit at steady state prefill p50 drops ~32% on both GPUs, decode tok/sec remains similar. Bench note: caching benefits are more pronounced on A100 where prefill is a larger fraction.
sam: Quantization notes? q4_0 vs q8x4 impact on quality/cost?
alex: q4_0 on H100 gave ~3-4% throughput bump vs q8x4 on 7B, and negligible quality diffs on our evalset for Mosaic. For 13B q4_0 currently unstable on A100 kernels -> had to run q8x4. So tradeoff is often constrained by kernel availability.
priya: Any thermal throttling or sustained perf drop in eu-west host?
alex: We saw mild thermal throttling on A100 under sustained 13B load in eu-west (p95 spike after ~6h). H100 hosts in same zone were stable across 12h run. We flagged infra to check room cooling timeline.
jen: Do you have per-route routing suggestions? e.g., send short-chat QPS -> A100; long context heavy -> H100?
alex: Short answer: H100 for high QPS, prefills-heavy or 13B. A100 can be cost-competitive for very latency-tolerant, long-tail workloads if you accept kernel fallbacks and slightly higher $/1M. Consider autoscale ramp with policy: prefer H100 until utilization >80% then spill to A100 for overflow.
sam: Can you attach the raw CSV + pprof IDs so I can re-run the cost model?
alex: Will push raw CSV to /bench/runs/run-3781 and drop pprof links in #eng-infra after this thread.
priya: One more — how did memory footprints look with kv-cache for 13B q8x4 on A100 vs H100?
alex: H100 had ~12% lower transient memory pressure due to different kernel allocation patterns; that reduced OOMs on heavy multi-tenant runs. A100 runs needed an extra 8GB headroom in our 13B configs.
benchbot: note: regression-checklist created -> ticket INF-BEN-3781, assigned to @alex.
jen: Thanks — helpful. Can we add a follow-up test: iso-power-consumption + cost-per-token with 24h sustained run?
alex: Yes — scheduling it next week with power telemetry. I'll ping when queued. :thumbsup:
priya: TL;DR for PMs: H100 generally better throughput and slightly better $/1M due to performance; A100 still viable for select workloads and region-cost tradeoffs.
sam: awesome, thanks alex.
